description:
About the company
 
 Our client is a software company serving industrial customers.
 
 The role
 
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Build full-stack AI agents and product features for complex operational workflows, from user interface through integrations and deployment.
 
 What you'll do
 
 - Develop AI agents for quoting, pricing, and related commercial workflows.
 
 - Own features across TypeScript, React, Next.js, and backend integrations.
 
 - Connect applications to enterprise resource planning systems.
 
 - Build deployments that meet European data-residency and privacy needs.
 
 - Use customer feedback and hands-on AI experimentation to improve the product.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 - 1 to 3 years of professional full-stack product engineering experience, with substantive work after graduation.
 
 - Experience building or deeply integrating AI systems beyond basic chatbot use.
 
 - Strong TypeScript and React skills.
 
 - Experience shipping products used by real customers and building with agent orchestration frameworks.
 
 - Active experimentation with new AI tools and development techniques.
 
 - Current Bay Area residence and ability to work onsite in San Francisco.
 
 Bonus points
 
 - Next.js experience.
 
 - Experience with enterprise integrations or data-residency requirements.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 200,000 per year.
 
 - Equity: 0.5-1%.
 
 - Free lunch and dinner when working late.
 
 - Customer travel opportunities.
 
 Location and work model
 
 - Five days per week onsite in San Francisco. The current search is limited to candidates already living in the Bay Area; relocation candidates are not being considered.
